purpose: Protected test-only handoff for private discovery of a member's own live voice rooms and actionable per-user-cap refusal

protectedFiles.change: Only the myroom_acceptance child-module registration was added; existing tests unchanged

commands.runtime: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot --lib --locked voice_rooms::tests::myroom_acceptance:: -- --nocapture --test-threads=1
commands.discovery: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --test voice_myroom_acceptance --locked -- --nocapture
commands.compatibility: python3 scripts/cargo_cache.py run -- test -p two-bot-core --test staging_publish_manifest --test smoke_surface_inventory --test registry_golden --test reference_docs --locked

expectedBaseline.note: Expected counts are a contract, not a claim that a Rust run was observed. Consult the task handoff for actual execution evidence.

boundaries.externalServices: No database, Discord, staging or production access; only stateful persistence and Discord doubles
boundaries.runtime: Real parser, authority/access gates, runtime actor channel, production apply_command and response rendering; the command-only actor driver excludes unrelated timer maintenance
boundaries.liveState: The loaded worker owns two caller rooms and one other-owner room; stored room rows and privacy are deliberately changed after load, and a room-store read is scripted to fail
boundaries.readOnly: Before-read snapshots pin persisted and runtime room/privacy state, the pending mutation queue, create claims, overwrite writes and effect trace

contract.cap: UserCap messages link all known caller-owned tracked rooms, not rooms merely created originally by the caller; unknown-room fallback and all four non-cap messages remain byte-identical
contract.admission: Pure reason codes/messages remain context-free; a refusal claims once, precedes every Discord write, binds/settles nothing and never retries
contract.memberRead: One ephemeral /myroom reply lists only authenticated current-owner live tracked rooms, including channel links and associated public/private state; being outside voice is allowed
contract.empty: No owned live room is stated truthfully, with joining a creator lobby as the next action
contract.discovery: Exactly one guild-only no-option ordinary-member command with voice on; voice sink owns dispatch before custom rows; help lists it with the member voice commands
contract.compatibility: Builder owns staging voice publish manifest, help/count pins and rendered docs/commands.md. Existing voice-off smoke/legacy registry fixtures must remain truthful; do not increase voice-off counts for a voice-only surface.

handoff: Do not merge this deliberately failing test-only branch by itself.
Consume the immutable handoff SHA, preserve every protected file byte-for-byte and return test corrections to the test author.
The Builder owns the implementation and compatibility pins/docs, exact-head green required checks, independent review and squash auto-merge.
The acceptance task remains open until the intended assertion failures and passing controls have been observed; a cache admission refusal is not RED evidence.
